title: Cite every matching import line as third-party evidence

comments.author: os
comments.text: Branch fix/import-evidence-line cited only the first import that matched a third-party service, so a local import like ./config exporting stripeMode could steal the citation from import Stripe from 'stripe'. Change: detectThirdPartyServicesFromImportsWithConfig now emits one external_api_call finding per distinct import span per service; classifyRawFindings already unions those into one component with all sourceLocations and serviceName/client evidence refs. Test added in tests/unit/patterns/import-evidence-line.spec.ts. Follow-up: pin @dataparade/cli to the new scanner commit and publish.

comments.author: os
comments.text: Landed. Scanner: 94accc8 (fix) + 74cc677 (record) on fix/import-evidence-line, pushed. CLI: dataparade@0d293b1d pins @dataparade/scanner#74cc677, bumps to 0.0.16, and updates graph-mapping.spec for the self-loop edge filter from scanner 62123b6. Tag cli-v0.0.16 pushed; release workflow run 36434354268 succeeded and published @dataparade/cli@0.0.16 to npm. Note: fix/import-evidence-line is not yet merged to scanner main. Frontend gap: ThirdPartyPropertyPanel has no evidenceKey for serviceName/client, so these refs are stored but not rendered there.
